notes: This file stores Monday 8am Google Maps reference times for direct Central line station pairs so future work does not need to re-query Google Maps.
Pairs with no Central option remain in the dataset with captureStatus set to no-central-option-found.
These values feed the app rush-hour tube-time graph directly, with graphRunMinutes retained only as a fallback where Google Maps did not return a direct option.
